'''Skolin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] who served in the military of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During a mission on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], Skolin and his squad were sent to raid a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] outpost in the [[Tularan Marsh]]. However, the pirates were infected by the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] and attacked Skolin's squad. Skolin fended off the [[rakghoul]]s, but was badly injured during the attack. He asked an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]-allied individual to finish his mission and sabotage the power generators outside the outpost in order to wipe out the rakghouls.
